description: Implement ATR's real three-level initial execution model policy. Create src/atr/task_policy.py exporting select_initial(task, models, routing=None, complexity=None). Return a dict with complexity (simple/medium/complex), tier, model, effort, and nonempty reason. Use the existing platform-independent Model, ATRException, analyze, choose_model, TIERS and EFFORTS from atr.core; no actual model names or Codex-specific format in this module. Map analyze low/normal/high to simple/medium/complex. Default policies: simple fast/low; medium balanced/medium; complex reasoning/high. A manual complexity argument overrides inference and must be one of the three names. routing is a table keyed only by simple/medium/complex; each table may override tier, model, effort, no other fields. Validate ALL configured rules including inactive ones; accept tomlkit table/integer wrappers where relevant, do not mutate input. Reject invalid structures, unknown tiers/efforts/fields, missing pinned models, empty models, and explicitly unsupported effort with ATRException. For default effort unsupported by a selected model, choose the nearest supported EFFORTS value; if none has a known ordering, use a supported catalog value. Missing tiers can fall back through choose_model, with an explanatory reason. Respect an explicitly pinned model from the supplied models list. Add meaningful pytest tests in tests/test_task_policy.py, covering defaults, actual TOML overrides, manual complexity, malformed/inactive rules, missing tiers, and explicit effort errors. Modify no other files. This feature is genuinely needed by the new execution CLI and is not a synthetic benchmark.
